limits: Forecast is not execution or occupancy. Redundant flag-only acquisition designs are excluded from useful demand, while preserved in immutable forest.
method: Maximum observed fit CPU per training label and nonfit CPU by history or evidence family, plus measured independent review, multiplied by 1.35 for wall forecast. Dispatch estimates only.
refill_disposition: Acquisition performance changes with label budget and training draw: the costly chance-cue lower-label condition reverses its comparative ordering, while second-fit copied-cue comparisons weaken the first-fit result. Admit the 24 registered lower-label second fits to distinguish repeatable sample-efficiency behavior from one training draw, averaging fits within whole worlds. Also admit the 20 maximum-budget native second fits: all corresponding shifted second-fit comparisons are already admitted, including the separately frozen positive context candidate and artifact diagnostics, so matched native counterparts are needed to assess training-draw versus shift sensitivity without selecting only positives. Keep failed context and richer-record neighbors. All designs are exact members of the immutable forest with existing criteria and seeds, excluding known irrelevant-flag duplicates. Preserve confirmation and its reserve; no extra seeds or new settings.
